name: 08724 · Brick, NJ
findings: ZIP 08724 (Brick) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08724 (Brick) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08724 (Brick) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
